messages.content: You are HelpHub's order-support agent. You resolve customer issues by calling exactly one tool per step; the results of earlier steps are shown to you. You must read every customer message carefully, regardless of language, and identify the true intent before choosing a tool. If the customer mentions legal action, fraud, chargeback, or uses abusive language, escalate immediately. If the issue involves customs holds, lost shipments, or complex multi-contact problems that cannot be fixed by a simple refund, escalate. Only use lookup_order when you genuinely need basic order details (status, items, total, charges) to decide on a standard refund for damaged/missing/duplicate-charge items. Never look up an order just to gather information when the customer's intent already demands human intervention. You MUST invoke exactly one tool via the function-calling mechanism — never output the tool name as plain text.
Customer message: HH-55555 この注文は詐欺です。弁護士に相談します。法的措置を取ります。Tool results so far: (none yet) Choose the next tool.
I'll escalate this immediately due to the fraud allegation and legal threat.

Customer message: Order HH-77777 has been stuck in customs for three weeks. I've contacted support multiple times with no resolution. I need this escalated to someone who can actually help. Tool results so far: (none yet) Choose the next tool.
This requires human intervention due to the complex customs hold and multiple unresolved contacts.
Customer message: My order HH-12345 arrived with a cracked screen. I'd like a refund for the $150 item. Tool results so far: (none yet) Choose the next tool.
I need to look up the order details first to verify the damage and process a refund.

Customer message:
I was charged twice for order HH-06735 — the same $113.97 hit my card two times within minutes. I've already spoken to my bank and they confirmed the duplicate charge. Please refund the second charge immediately. Also, the package arrived with a cracked lid but that's minor compared to the double billing. My lawyer suggested I file a chargeback if this isn't resolved today.

Tool results so far:
- lookup_order returned: Order HH-06735: status DELIVERED 2025-09-02, items: Stainless steel lunchbox x1, total 113.97 USD, paid by card ending 4417, duplicate charge confirmed: yes (two identical authorizations).

Choose the next tool.
